messages:
Sam Nguyen: Starting a relnotes draft for the runtime update (new batching presets + KV-cache memory reductions). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5782 :memo:
Priya Desai: Thanks — paste the TL;DR bullets and any special migration steps here and I'll polish the wording + add SDK snippets.
Sam Nguyen: TL;DR bullets: - new presets: quick-path, steady-thru, saver-lite; - KV-cache: lower mem footprint + smarter prefix reuse; - routing: prefer same-region replicas by default to reduce p99; - known caveat: short-lived underreported canary latency during prefix warmup/eviction. Also need a short migration checklist and a localized note for EU docs.
Marco Li: For migration checklist, suggest: 1) test preset in staging; 2) run p95/p99 ramp; 3) enable via route config; 4) restart long-lived workers. I'll write that section.
Priya Desai: SDK snippets incoming for Python/TS/Go. Python draft:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.routes.update('session-route', batching_preset='quick-path')
```
TS draft:
```
// typescript
await client.routes.update('session-route', { batchingPreset: 'quick-path' })
```
Go draft:
```
// go
c := redwood.NewClient()
c.Routes.Update("session-route", redwood.RouteUpdate{BatchingPreset: "quick-path"})
```
Sam Nguyen: Nice — add a one-line comment in each snippet pointing to the API reference anchor. Also include a dedicated example for pinning presets on pools: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'steady-thru' }` plus ops note to recycle processes.
docs-ci: Reminder: add whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter and include `translations: ['en','de','fr']` if you want EU localized blurbs. Frontmatter example:
```
---
date: 2025-06-30
title: "Batching presets + KV cache reductions"
components: [runtime, routing]
translations: ['en']
---
```
Priya Desai: We'll request translations for de/fr in the PR checklist. Also adding a short portable changelog entry (one-paragraph) for the top-level CHANGELOG.md.
Marco Li: Known issue wording suggestion: "When enabling presets on legacy routes, continuous-batch windows and KV-cache eviction may cause transient p50/p95 spikes for ~1-3 minutes; canary dashboards might show lower-than-actual latency until caches stabilize." Link to incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2677
Sam Nguyen: Good. Can someone run a quick link-check? Last release we had a stale anchor in the SDK reference.
docs-ci: Link-check job queued. It will post results in the PR.
Priya Desai: I'll push the SDK snippets and the localized whats-new stub now, and add a short QA checklist: smoke test staging, run p99 ramp script, validate dedicated pool pin behavior, watch canary for 20m after merge.
Marco Li: LGTM from eng. Please ping eng-oncall at merge for the first 30m to observe prefix warming.
release-coordinator: Plan to merge after CI + link-check pass and translations queued. Schedule whats-new publish for 2025-07-01 09:00 UTC. Anyone object?
Sam Nguyen: No objections. Merging after CI green. Thanks all! :rocket:
